patterns.note: The site uses a combination of full-bleed hero imagery, asymmetrical grid layouts for lifestyle sections, and consistent product card grids for showcasing items.
Section headings are large, bold, and uppercase sans-serif, contrasting with a lighter weight, readable sans-serif for body text and smaller, uppercase labels.
A neutral palette of whites, light greys, and black dominates, complemented by warm gold/beige tones from product photography and subtle earthy accents.
The header transforms from a transparent overlay to a compact, opaque black bar upon scroll, and the hero background image exhibits a subtle parallax effect.
Content is structured with aspirational lifestyle photography sections, dedicated product showcases, and clear informational blocks, all leading to a comprehensive multi-column footer.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar dynamically changes its appearance and size upon scroll, transitioning from a transparent overlay with a larger logo to a compact, opaque black bar with a reduced height and logo size, providing a consistent sticky navigation experience.
A subtle parallax effect is applied to the hero background image, where it scrolls at a slower pace than the overlaying text and subsequent page content, adding depth to the initial view.

Content sections throughout the page are revealed with a staggered animation, typically a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation, as they become visible within the user's viewport, likely powered by a library like GSAP ScrollTrigger.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3x body) with smaller, uppercase labels and clear, readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: subtle (mostly sharp edges with minimal rounding on interactive elements)
design_tokens.spacing: balanced to airy; generous spacing around major sections and within product grids, creating a clean and uncluttered feel

standout: The site stands out with its sophisticated use of large-scale, high-quality lifestyle photography that integrates seamlessly with product showcases, creating an aspirational and editorial feel. The subtle motion effects, particularly the hero parallax and scroll-triggered reveals, add a layer of polish without distracting from the content.
